verses.ar: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَنۡزَلَ عَلٰي عَبۡدِهِ الۡكِتٰبَ وَلَمۡ يَجۡعَلۡ لَّهٗ عِوَجًاؕࣝ‏
verses.en: Praise be to Allah, Who hath sent to His Servant the Book, and hath allowed therein no Crookedness

verses.ar: قَيِّمًا لِّيُنۡذِرَ بَاۡسًا شَدِيۡدًا مِّنۡ لَّدُنۡهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ الَّذِيۡنَ يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ اَنَّ لَهُمۡ اَجۡرًا حَسَنًاۙ‏
verses.en: (He hath made it) Straight (and Clear) in order that He may warn (the godless) of a terrible Punishment from Him, and that He may give Glad Tidings to the Believers who work righteous deeds, that they shall have a goodly Reward

verses.ar: مَّاكِثِيۡنَ فِيۡهِ اَبَدًاۙ‏
verses.en: Wherein they shall remain for ever

verses.ar: وَّيُنۡذِرَ الَّذِيۡنَ قَالُوا اتَّخَذَ اللّٰهُ وَلَدًاࣗ‏
verses.en: Further, that He may warn those (also) who say, "Allah hath begotten a son

verses.ar: مَا لَهُمۡ بِهٖ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍ وَّلَا لِاٰبَآئِهِمۡؕ كَبُرَتۡ كَلِمَةً تَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ اَفۡوَاهِهِمۡؕ اِنۡ يَّقُوۡلُوۡنَ اِلَّا كَذِبًا
verses.en: No knowledge have they of such a thing, nor had their fathers. It is a grievous thing that issues from their mouths as a saying what they say is nothing but falsehood

verses.ar: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفۡسَكَ عَلٰ٘ي اٰثَارِهِمۡ اِنۡ لَّمۡ يُؤۡمِنُوۡا بِهٰذَا الۡحَدِيۡثِ اَسَفًا
verses.en: Thou wouldst only, perchance, fret thyself to death, following after them, in grief, if they believe not in this Message

verses.ar: اِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا مَا عَلَي الۡاَرۡضِ زِيۡنَةً لَّهَا لِنَبۡلُوَهُمۡ اَيُّهُمۡ اَحۡسَنُ عَمَلًا
verses.en: That which is on earth we have made but as a glittering show for the earth, in order that We may test them - as to which of them are best in conduct

verses.ar: وَاِنَّا لَجٰعِلُوۡنَ مَا عَلَيۡهَا صَعِيۡدًا جُرُزًاؕ‏
verses.en: Verily what is on earth we shall make but as dust and dry soil (without growth or herbage)

verses.ar: اَمۡ حَسِبۡتَ اَنَّ اَصۡحٰبَ الۡكَهۡفِ وَالرَّقِيۡمِ كَانُوۡا مِنۡ اٰيٰتِنَا عَجَبًا
verses.en: Or dost thou reflect that the Companions of the Cave and of the Inscription were wonders among Our Sign

verses.ar: اِذۡ اَوَي الۡفِتۡيَةُ اِلَي الۡكَهۡفِ فَقَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا٘ اٰتِنَا مِنۡ لَّدُنۡكَ رَحۡمَةً وَّهَيِّئۡ لَنَا مِنۡ اَمۡرِنَا رَشَدًا
verses.en: Behold, the youths betook themselves to the Cave: they said, "Our Lord! bestow on us Mercy from Thyself, and dispose of our affair for us in the right way

verses.ar: فَضَرَبۡنَا عَلٰ٘ي اٰذَانِهِمۡ فِي الۡكَهۡفِ سِنِيۡنَ عَدَدًاۙ‏
verses.en: Then We draw (a veil) over their ears, for a number of years, in the Cave, (so that they heard not)

verses.ar: ثُمَّ بَعَثۡنٰهُمۡ لِنَعۡلَمَ اَيُّ الۡحِزۡبَيۡنِ اَحۡصٰي لِمَا لَبِثُوۡ٘ا اَمَدًاࣖ‏
verses.en: Then We roused them, in order to test which of the two parties was best at calculating the term of years they had tarried

verses.ar: نَحۡنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ نَبَاَهُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّؕ اِنَّهُمۡ فِتۡيَةٌ اٰمَنُوۡا بِرَبِّهِمۡ وَزِدۡنٰهُمۡ هُدًيࣗۖ‏
verses.en: We relate to thee their story in truth: they were youths who believed in their Lord, and We advanced them in guidance

verses.ar: وَّرَبَطۡنَا عَلٰي قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ اِذۡ قَامُوۡا فَقَالُوۡا رَبُّنَا رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ لَنۡ نَّدۡعُوَا۠ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اِلٰهًا لَّقَدۡ قُلۡنَا٘ اِذًا شَطَطًا
verses.en: We gave strength to their hearts: Behold, they stood up and said: "Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and of the earth: never shall we call upon any god other than Him: if we did, we should indeed have uttered an enormity

verses.ar: هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمُنَا اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اٰلِهَةًؕ لَوۡلَا يَاۡتُوۡنَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِسُلۡطٰنٍۭ بَيِّنٍؕ فَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ افۡتَرٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًاؕ‏
verses.en: These our people have taken for worship gods other than Him: why do they not bring forward an authority clear (and convincing) for what they do? Who doth more wrong than such as invent a falsehood against Allah

verses.ar: وَاِذِ اعۡتَزَلۡتُمُوۡهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُوۡنَ اِلَّا اللّٰهَ فَاۡوٗ٘ا اِلَي الۡكَهۡفِ يَنۡشُرۡ لَكُمۡ رَبُّكُمۡ مِّنۡ رَّحۡمَتِهٖ وَيُهَيِّئۡ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَمۡرِكُمۡ مِّرۡفَقًا
verses.en: When ye turn away from them and the things they worship other than Allah, betake yourselves to the Cave: Your Lord will shower His mercies on you and disposes of your affair towards comfort and ease

verses.ar: وَتَرَي الشَّمۡسَ اِذَا طَلَعَتۡ تَّزٰوَرُ عَنۡ كَهۡفِهِمۡ ذَاتَ الۡيَمِيۡنِ وَاِذَا غَرَبَتۡ تَّقۡرِضُهُمۡ ذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ وَهُمۡ فِيۡ فَجۡوَةٍ مِّنۡهُؕ ذٰلِكَ مِنۡ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِؕ مَنۡ يَّهۡدِ اللّٰهُ فَهُوَ الۡمُهۡتَدِۚ وَمَنۡ يُّضۡلِلۡ فَلَنۡ تَجِدَ لَهٗ وَلِيًّا مُّرۡشِدًاࣖ‏
verses.en: Thou wouldst have seen the sun, when it rose, declining to the right from their Cave, and when it set, turning away from them to the left, while they lay in the open space in the midst of the Cave. Such are among the Signs of Allah: He whom Allah, guides is rightly guided; but he whom Allah leaves to stray,- for him wilt thou find no protector to lead him to the Right Way

verses.ar: وَتَحۡسَبُهُمۡ اَيۡقَاظًا وَّهُمۡ رُقُوۡدٌࣗۖ وَّنُقَلِّبُهُمۡ ذَاتَ الۡيَمِيۡنِ وَذَاتَ الشِّمَالِࣗۖ وَكَلۡبُهُمۡ بَاسِطٌ ذِرَاعَيۡهِ بِالۡوَصِيۡدِؕ لَوِ اطَّلَعۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ لَوَلَّيۡتَ مِنۡهُمۡ فِرَارًا وَّلَمُلِئۡتَ مِنۡهُمۡ رُعۡبًا
verses.en: Thou wouldst have deemed them awake, whilst they were asleep, and We turned them on their right and on their left sides: their dog stretching forth his two fore-legs on the threshold: if thou hadst come up on to them, thou wouldst have certainly turned back from them in flight, and wouldst certainly have been filled with terror of them

verses.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ بَعَثۡنٰهُمۡ لِيَتَسَآءَلُوۡا بَيۡنَهُمۡؕ قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنۡهُمۡ كَمۡ لَبِثۡتُمۡؕ قَالُوۡا لَبِثۡنَا يَوۡمًا اَوۡ بَعۡضَ يَوۡمٍؕ قَالُوۡا رَبُّكُمۡ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثۡتُمۡؕ فَابۡعَثُوۡ٘ا اَحَدَكُمۡ بِوَرِقِكُمۡ هٰذِهٖ٘ اِلَي الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ فَلۡيَنۡظُرۡ اَيُّهَا٘ اَزۡكٰي طَعَامًا فَلۡيَاۡتِكُمۡ بِرِزۡقٍ مِّنۡهُ وَلۡيَتَۙلَطَّفۡ وَلَا يُشۡعِرَنَّ بِكُمۡ اَحَدًا
verses.en: Such (being their state), we raised them up (from sleep), that they might question each other. Said one of them, "How long have ye stayed (here)?" They said, "We have stayed (perhaps) a day, or part of a day." (At length) they (all) said, "Allah (alone) knows best how long ye have stayed here.... Now send ye then one of you with this money of yours to the town: let him find out which is the best food (to be had) and bring some to you, that (ye may) satisfy your hunger therewith: And let him behave with care and courtesy, and let him not inform any one about you

verses.ar: اِنَّهُمۡ اِنۡ يَّظۡهَرُوۡا عَلَيۡكُمۡ يَرۡجُمُوۡكُمۡ اَوۡ يُعِيۡدُوۡكُمۡ فِيۡ مِلَّتِهِمۡ وَلَنۡ تُفۡلِحُوۡ٘ا اِذًا اَبَدًا
verses.en: For if they should come upon you, they would stone you or force you to return to their cult, and in that case ye would never attain prosperity

verses.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَعۡثَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ لِيَعۡلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنَّ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّاَنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيۡهَاࣗۚ اِذۡ يَتَنَازَعُوۡنَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ اَمۡرَهُمۡ فَقَالُوا ابۡنُوۡا عَلَيۡهِمۡ بُنۡيَانًاؕ رَبُّهُمۡ اَعۡلَمُ بِهِمۡؕ قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ غَلَبُوۡا عَلٰ٘ي اَمۡرِهِمۡ لَنَتَّخِذَنَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ مَّسۡجِدًا
verses.en: Thus did We make their case known to the people, that they might know that the promise of Allah is true, and that there can be no doubt about the Hour of Judgment. Behold, they dispute among themselves as to their affair. (Some) said, "Construct a building over them": Their Lord knows best about them: those who prevailed over their affair said, "Let us surely build a place of worship over them

verses.ar: سَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ ثَلٰثَةٌ رَّابِعُهُمۡ كَلۡبُهُمۡۚ وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ خَمۡسَةٌ سَادِسُهُمۡ كَلۡبُهُمۡ رَجۡمًاۭ بِالۡغَيۡبِۚ وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ سَبۡعَةٌ وَّثَامِنُهُمۡ كَلۡبُهُمۡؕ قُلۡ رَّبِّيۡ٘ اَعۡلَمُ بِعِدَّتِهِمۡ مَّا يَعۡلَمُهُمۡ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلٌ ࣢ࣞ فَلَا تُمَارِ فِيۡهِمۡ اِلَّا مِرَآءً ظَاهِرًاࣕ وَّلَا تَسۡتَفۡتِ فِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡهُمۡ اَحَدًاࣖ‏
verses.en: (Some) say they were three, the dog being the fourth among them; (others) say they were five, the dog being the sixth,- doubtfully guessing at the unknown; (yet others) say they were seven, the dog being the eighth. Say thou: "My Lord knoweth best their number; It is but few that know their (real case)." Enter not, therefore, into controversies concerning them, except on a matter that is clear, nor consult any of them about (the affair of) the Sleepers

verses.ar: وَلَا تَقُوۡلَنَّ لِشَايۡءٍ اِنِّيۡ فَاعِلٌ ذٰلِكَ غَدًاۙ‏
verses.en: Nor say of anything, "I shall be sure to do so and so tomorrow

verses.ar: اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ يَّشَآءَ اللّٰهُؗ وَاذۡكُرۡ رَّبَّكَ اِذَا نَسِيۡتَ وَقُلۡ عَسٰ٘ي اَنۡ يَّهۡدِيَنِ رَبِّيۡ لِاَقۡرَبَ مِنۡ هٰذَا رَشَدًا
verses.en: Without adding, "So please Allah!" and call thy Lord to mind when thou forgettest, and say, "I hope that my Lord will guide me ever closer (even) than this to the right road

verses.ar: وَلَبِثُوۡا فِيۡ كَهۡفِهِمۡ ثَلٰثَ مِائَةٍ سِنِيۡنَ وَازۡدَادُوۡا تِسۡعًا
verses.en: So they stayed in their Cave three hundred years, and (some) add nine (more)

verses.ar: قُلِ اللّٰهُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثُوۡاۚ لَهٗ غَيۡبُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ اَبۡصِرۡ بِهٖ وَاَسۡمِعۡؕ مَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مِنۡ وَّلِيٍّؗ وَّلَا يُشۡرِكُ فِيۡ حُكۡمِهٖ٘ اَحَدًا
verses.en: Say: "Allah knows best how long they stayed: with Him is (the knowledge of) the secrets of the heavens and the earth: how clearly He sees, how finely He hears (everything)! They have no protector other than Him; nor does He share His Command with any person whatsoever

verses.ar: وَاتۡلُ مَا٘ اُوۡحِيَ اِلَيۡكَ مِنۡ كِتَابِ رَبِّكَؕ لَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمٰتِهٖۚࣞ وَلَنۡ تَجِدَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مُلۡتَحَدًا
verses.en: And recite (and teach) what has been revealed to thee of the Book of thy Lord: none can change His Words, and none wilt thou find as a refuge other than Him

verses.ar: وَاصۡبِرۡ نَفۡسَكَ مَعَ الَّذِيۡنَ يَدۡعُوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ بِالۡغَدٰوةِ وَالۡعَشِيِّ يُرِيۡدُوۡنَ وَجۡهَهٗ وَلَا تَعۡدُ عَيۡنٰكَ عَنۡهُمۡۚ تُرِيۡدُ زِيۡنَةَ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاۚ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مَنۡ اَغۡفَلۡنَا قَلۡبَهٗ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِنَا وَاتَّبَعَ هَوٰىهُ وَكَانَ اَمۡرُهٗ فُرُطًا
verses.en: And keep thy soul content with those who call on their Lord morning and evening, seeking His Face; and let not thine eyes pass beyond them, seeking the pomp and glitter of this Life; no obey any whose heart We have permitted to neglect the remembrance of Us, one who follows his own desires, whose case has gone beyond all bounds

verses.ar: وَقُلِ الۡحَقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡࣞ فَمَنۡ شَآءَ فَلۡيُؤۡمِنۡ وَّمَنۡ شَآءَ فَلۡيَكۡفُرۡۚ اِنَّا٘ اَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلظّٰلِمِيۡنَ نَارًا اَحَاطَ بِهِمۡ سُرَادِقُهَاؕ وَاِنۡ يَّسۡتَغِيۡثُوۡا يُغَاثُوۡا بِمَآءٍ كَالۡمُهۡلِ يَشۡوِي الۡوُجُوۡهَؕ بِئۡسَ الشَّرَابُؕ وَسَآءَتۡ مُرۡتَفَقًا
verses.en: Say, "The truth is from your Lord": Let him who will believe, and let him who will, reject (it): for the wrong-doers We have prepared a Fire whose (smoke and flames), like the walls and roof of a tent, will hem them in: if they implore relief they will be granted water like melted brass, that will scald their faces, how dreadful the drink! How uncomfortable a couch to recline on

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ اِنَّا لَا نُضِيۡعُ اَجۡرَ مَنۡ اَحۡسَنَ عَمَلًاۚ‏
verses.en: As to those who believe and work righteousness, verily We shall not suffer to perish the reward of any who do a (single) righteous deed

verses.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ جَنّٰتُ عَدۡنٍ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهِمُ الۡاَنۡهٰرُ يُحَلَّوۡنَ فِيۡهَا مِنۡ اَسَاوِرَ مِنۡ ذَهَبٍ وَّيَلۡبَسُوۡنَ ثِيَابًا خُضۡرًا مِّنۡ سُنۡدُسٍ وَّاِسۡتَبۡرَقٍ مُّتَّكِـِٕيۡنَ فِيۡهَا عَلَي الۡاَرَآئِكِؕ نِعۡمَ الثَّوَابُؕ وَحَسُنَتۡ مُرۡتَفَقًاࣖ‏
verses.en: For them will be Gardens of Eternity; beneath them rivers will flow; they will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold, and they will wear green garments of fine silk and heavy brocade: They will recline therein on raised thrones. How good the recompense! How beautiful a couch to recline on

verses.ar: وَاضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ مَّثَلًا رَّجُلَيۡنِ جَعَلۡنَا لِاَحَدِهِمَا جَنَّتَيۡنِ مِنۡ اَعۡنَابٍ وَّحَفَفۡنٰهُمَا بِنَخۡلٍ وَّجَعَلۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمَا زَرۡعًاؕ‏
verses.en: Set forth to them the parable of two men: for one of them We provided two gardens of grape-vines and surrounded them with date palms; in between the two We placed corn-fields

verses.ar: كِلۡتَا الۡجَنَّتَيۡنِ اٰتَتۡ اُكُلَهَا وَلَمۡ تَظۡلِمۡ مِّنۡهُ شَيۡـًٔاۙ وَّفَجَّرۡنَا خِلٰلَهُمَا نَهَرًاۙ‏
verses.en: Each of those gardens brought forth its produce, and failed not in the least therein: in the midst of them We caused a river to flow

verses.ar: وَّكَانَ لَهٗ ثَمَرٌۚ فَقَالَ لِصَاحِبِهٖ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهٗ٘ اَنَا اَكۡثَرُ مِنۡكَ مَالًا وَّاَعَزُّ نَفَرًا
verses.en: (Abundant) was the produce this man had: he said to his companion, in the course of a mutual argument: "more wealth have I than you, and more honour and power in (my following of) men

verses.ar: وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهٗ وَهُوَ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفۡسِهٖۚ قَالَ مَا٘ اَظُنُّ اَنۡ تَبِيۡدَ هٰذِهٖ٘ اَبَدًاۙ‏
verses.en: He went into his garden in a state (of mind) unjust to his soul: He said, "I deem not that this will ever perish

verses.ar: وَّمَا٘ اَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةًۙ وَّلَئِنۡ رُّدِدۡتُّ اِلٰي رَبِّيۡ لَاَجِدَنَّ خَيۡرًا مِّنۡهَا مُنۡقَلَبًاۚ‏
verses.en: Nor do I deem that the Hour (of Judgment) will (ever) come: Even if I am brought back to my Lord, I shall surely find (there) something better in exchange

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهٗ صَاحِبُهٗ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهٗ٘ اَكَفَرۡتَ بِالَّذِيۡ خَلَقَكَ مِنۡ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنۡ نُّطۡفَةٍ ثُمَّ سَوّٰىكَ رَجُلًاؕ‏
verses.en: His companion said to him, in the course of the argument with him: "Dost thou deny Him Who created thee out of dust, then out of a sperm-drop, then fashioned thee into a man

verses.ar: لٰكِنَّا۠ هُوَ اللّٰهُ رَبِّيۡ وَلَا٘ اُشۡرِكُ بِرَبِّيۡ٘ اَحَدًا
verses.en: But (I think) for my part that He is Allah, My Lord, and none shall I associate with my Lord

verses.ar: وَلَوۡلَا٘ اِذۡ دَخَلۡتَ جَنَّتَكَ قُلۡتَ مَا شَآءَ اللّٰهُۙ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِۚ اِنۡ تَرَنِ اَنَا اَقَلَّ مِنۡكَ مَالًا وَّوَلَدًاۚ‏
verses.en: Why didst thou not, as thou wentest into thy garden, say: 'Allah's will (be done)! There is no power but with Allah!' If thou dost see me less than thee in wealth and sons

verses.ar: فَعَسٰي رَبِّيۡ٘ اَنۡ يُّؤۡتِيَنِ خَيۡرًا مِّنۡ جَنَّتِكَ وَيُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهَا حُسۡبَانًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ فَتُصۡبِحَ صَعِيۡدًا زَلَقًاۙ‏
verses.en: It may be that my Lord will give me something better than thy garden, and that He will send on thy garden thunderbolts (by way of reckoning) from heaven, making it (but) slippery sand

verses.ar: اَوۡ يُصۡبِحَ مَآؤُهَا غَوۡرًا فَلَنۡ تَسۡتَطِيۡعَ لَهٗ طَلَبًا
verses.en: Or the water of the garden will run off underground so that thou wilt never be able to find it

verses.ar: وَاُحِيۡطَ بِثَمَرِهٖ فَاَصۡبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيۡهِ عَلٰي مَا٘ اَنۡفَقَ فِيۡهَا وَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلٰي عُرُوۡشِهَا وَيَقُوۡلُ يٰلَيۡتَنِيۡ لَمۡ اُشۡرِكۡ بِرَبِّيۡ٘ اَحَدًا
verses.en: So his fruits (and enjoyment) were encompassed (with ruin), and he remained twisting and turning his hands over what he had spent on his property, which had (now) tumbled to pieces to its very foundations, and he could only say, "Woe is me! Would I had never ascribed partners to my Lord and Cherisher

verses.ar: وَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ لَّهٗ فِئَةٌ يَّنۡصُرُوۡنَهٗ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ وَمَا كَانَ مُنۡتَصِرًاؕ‏
verses.en: Nor had he numbers to help him against Allah, nor was he able to deliver himself

verses.ar: هُنَالِكَ الۡوَلَايَةُ لِلّٰهِ الۡحَقِّؕ هُوَ خَيۡرٌ ثَوَابًا وَّخَيۡرٌ عُقۡبًاࣖ‏
verses.en: There, the (only) protection comes from Allah, the True One. He is the Best to reward, and the Best to give success

verses.ar: وَاضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ مَّثَلَ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا كَمَآءٍ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ فَاخۡتَلَطَ بِهٖ نَبَاتُ الۡاَرۡضِ فَاَصۡبَحَ هَشِيۡمًا تَذۡرُوۡهُ الرِّيٰحُؕ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ مُّقۡتَدِرًا
verses.en: Set forth to them the similitude of the life of this world: It is like the rain which we send down from the skies: the earth's vegetation absorbs it, but soon it becomes dry stubble, which the winds do scatter: it is (only) Allah who prevails over all things

verses.ar: اَلۡمَالُ وَالۡبَنُوۡنَ زِيۡنَةُ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاۚ وَالۡبٰقِيٰتُ الصّٰلِحٰتُ خَيۡرٌ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَّخَيۡرٌ اَمَلًا
verses.en: Wealth and sons are allurements of the life of this world: But the things that endure, good deeds, are best in the sight of thy Lord, as rewards, and best as (the foundation for) hopes

verses.ar: وَيَوۡمَ نُسَيِّرُ الۡجِبَالَ وَتَرَي الۡاَرۡضَ بَارِزَةًۙ وَّحَشَرۡنٰهُمۡ فَلَمۡ نُغَادِرۡ مِنۡهُمۡ اَحَدًاۚ‏
verses.en: One Day We shall remove the mountains, and thou wilt see the earth as a level stretch, and We shall gather them, all together, nor shall We leave out any one of them

verses.ar: وَعُرِضُوۡا عَلٰي رَبِّكَ صَفًّاؕ لَقَدۡ جِئۡتُمُوۡنَا كَمَا خَلَقۡنٰكُمۡ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۭؗ بَلۡ زَعَمۡتُمۡ اَلَّنۡ نَّجۡعَلَ لَكُمۡ مَّوۡعِدًا
verses.en: And they will be marshalled before thy Lord in ranks, (with the announcement), "Now have ye come to Us (bare) as We created you first: aye, ye thought We shall not fulfil the appointment made to you to meet (Us)

verses.ar: وَوُضِعَ الۡكِتٰبُ فَتَرَي الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ مُشۡفِقِيۡنَ مِمَّا فِيۡهِ وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ يٰوَيۡلَتَنَا مَالِ هٰذَا الۡكِتٰبِ لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيۡرَةً وَّلَا كَبِيۡرَةً اِلَّا٘ اَحۡصٰىهَاۚ وَوَجَدُوۡا مَا عَمِلُوۡا حَاضِرًاؕ وَلَا يَظۡلِمُ رَبُّكَ اَحَدًاࣖ‏
verses.en: And the Book (of Deeds) will be placed (before you); and thou wilt see the sinful in great terror because of what is (recorded) therein; they will say, "Ah! woe to us! what a Book is this! It leaves out nothing small or great, but takes account thereof!" They will find all that they did, placed before them: And not one will thy Lord treat with injustice

verses.ar: وَاِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اسۡجُدُوۡا لِاٰدَمَ فَسَجَدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا٘ اِبۡلِيۡسَؕ كَانَ مِنَ الۡجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَنۡ اَمۡرِ رَبِّهٖؕ اَفَتَتَّخِذُوۡنَهٗ وَذُرِّيَّتَهٗ٘ اَوۡلِيَآءَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِيۡ وَهُمۡ لَكُمۡ عَدُوٌّؕ بِئۡسَ لِلظّٰلِمِيۡنَ بَدَلًا
verses.en: Behold! We said to the angels, "Bow down to Adam": They bowed down except Iblis. He was one of the Jinns, and he broke the Command of his Lord. Will ye then take him and his progeny as protectors rather than Me? And they are enemies to you! Evil would be the exchange for the wrong-doers

verses.ar: مَا٘ اَشۡهَدۡتُّهُمۡ خَلۡقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا خَلۡقَ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡࣕ وَمَا كُنۡتُ مُتَّخِذَ الۡمُضِلِّيۡنَ عَضُدًا
verses.en: I called them not to witness the creation of the heavens and the earth, nor (even) their own creation: nor is it for helpers such as Me to take as lead (men) astray

verses.ar: وَيَوۡمَ يَقُوۡلُ نَادُوۡا شُرَكَآءِيَ الَّذِيۡنَ زَعَمۡتُمۡ فَدَعَوۡهُمۡ فَلَمۡ يَسۡتَجِيۡبُوۡا لَهُمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمۡ مَّوۡبِقًا
verses.en: One Day He will say, "Call on those whom ye thought to be My partners," and they will call on them, but they will not listen to them; and We shall make for them a place of common perdition

verses.ar: وَرَاَ الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ النَّارَ فَظَنُّوۡ٘ا اَنَّهُمۡ مُّوَاقِعُوۡهَا وَلَمۡ يَجِدُوۡا عَنۡهَا مَصۡرِفًاࣖ‏
verses.en: And the Sinful shall see the fire and apprehend that they have to fall therein: no means will they find to turn away therefrom

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنَا فِيۡ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنِ لِلنَّاسِ مِنۡ كُلِّ مَثَلٍؕ وَكَانَ الۡاِنۡسَانُ اَكۡثَرَ شَيۡءٍ جَدَلًا
verses.en: We have explained in detail in this Qur'an, for the benefit of mankind, every kind of similitude: but man is, in most things, contentious

verses.ar: وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ اَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡ٘ا اِذۡ جَآءَهُمُ الۡهُدٰي وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡا رَبَّهُمۡ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ تَاۡتِيَهُمۡ سُنَّةُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ اَوۡ يَاۡتِيَهُمُ الۡعَذَابُ قُبُلًا
verses.en: And what is there to keep back men from believing, now that Guidance has come to them, nor from praying for forgiveness from their Lord, but that (they ask that) the ways of the ancients be repeated with them, or the Wrath be brought to them face to face

verses.ar: وَمَا نُرۡسِلُ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَ اِلَّا مُبَشِّرِيۡنَ وَمُنۡذِرِيۡنَۚ وَيُجَادِلُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِالۡبَاطِلِ لِيُدۡحِضُوۡا بِهِ الۡحَقَّ وَاتَّخَذُوۡ٘ا اٰيٰتِيۡ وَمَا٘ اُنۡذِرُوۡا هُزُوًا
verses.en: We only send the messengers to give Glad Tidings and to give warnings: But the unbelievers dispute with vain argument, in order therewith to weaken the truth, and they treat My Signs as a jest, as also the fact that they are warned

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنۡ ذُكِّرَ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهٖ فَاَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهَا وَنَسِيَ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدٰهُؕ اِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا عَلٰي قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ اَكِنَّةً اَنۡ يَّفۡقَهُوۡهُ وَفِيۡ٘ اٰذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرًاؕ وَاِنۡ تَدۡعُهُمۡ اِلَي الۡهُدٰي فَلَنۡ يَّهۡتَدُوۡ٘ا اِذًا اَبَدًا
verses.en: And who doth more wrong than one who is reminded of the Signs of his Lord, but turns away from them, forgetting the (deeds) which his hands have sent forth? Verily We have set veils over their hearts lest they should understand this, and over their ears, deafness, if thou callest them to guidance, even then will they never accept guidance

verses.ar: وَرَبُّكَ الۡغَفُوۡرُ ذُو الرَّحۡمَةِؕ لَوۡ يُؤَاخِذُهُمۡ بِمَا كَسَبُوۡا لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ الۡعَذَابَؕ بَلۡ لَّهُمۡ مَّوۡعِدٌ لَّنۡ يَّجِدُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مَوۡئِلًا
verses.en: But your Lord is Most forgiving, full of Mercy. If He were to call them (at once) to account for what they have earned, then surely He would have hastened their punishment: but they have their appointed time, beyond which they will find no refuge

verses.ar: وَتِلۡكَ الۡقُرٰ٘ي اَهۡلَكۡنٰهُمۡ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوۡا وَجَعَلۡنَا لِمَهۡلِكِهِمۡ مَّوۡعِدًاࣖ‏
verses.en: Such were the populations we destroyed when they committed iniquities; but we fixed an appointed time for their destruction

verses.ar: وَاِذۡ قَالَ مُوۡسٰي لِفَتٰىهُ لَا٘ اَبۡرَحُ حَتّٰ٘ي اَبۡلُغَ مَجۡمَعَ الۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ اَوۡ اَمۡضِيَ حُقُبًا
verses.en: Behold, Moses said to his attendant, "I will not give up until I reach the junction of the two seas or (until) I spend years and years in travel

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجۡمَعَ بَيۡنِهِمَا نَسِيَا حُوۡتَهُمَا فَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيۡلَهٗ فِي الۡبَحۡرِ سَرَبًا
verses.en: But when they reached the Junction, they forgot (about) their Fish, which took its course through the sea (straight) as in a tunnel

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتٰىهُ اٰتِنَا غَدَآءَنَاؗ لَقَدۡ لَقِيۡنَا مِنۡ سَفَرِنَا هٰذَا نَصَبًا
verses.en: When they had passed on (some distance), Moses said to his attendant: "Bring us our early meal; truly we have suffered much fatigue at this (stage of) our journey

verses.ar: قَالَ اَرَءَيۡتَ اِذۡ اَوَيۡنَا٘ اِلَي الصَّخۡرَةِ فَاِنِّيۡ نَسِيۡتُ الۡحُوۡتَؗ وَمَا٘ اَنۡسٰىنِيۡهُ اِلَّا الشَّيۡطٰنُ اَنۡ اَذۡكُرَهٗۚ وَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيۡلَهٗ فِي الۡبَحۡرِࣗۖ عَجَبًا
verses.en: He replied: "Sawest thou (what happened) when we betook ourselves to the rock? I did indeed forget (about) the Fish: none but Satan made me forget to tell (you) about it: it took its course through the sea in a marvellous way

verses.ar: قَالَ ذٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبۡغِࣗۖ فَارۡتَدَّا عَلٰ٘ي اٰثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًاۙ‏
verses.en: Moses said: "That was what we were seeking after:" So they went back on their footsteps, following (the path they had come)

verses.ar: فَوَجَدَا عَبۡدًا مِّنۡ عِبَادِنَا٘ اٰتَيۡنٰهُ رَحۡمَةً مِّنۡ عِنۡدِنَا وَعَلَّمۡنٰهُ مِنۡ لَّدُنَّا عِلۡمًا
verses.en: So they found one of Our servants, on whom We had bestowed Mercy from Ourselves and whom We had taught knowledge from Our own Presence

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهٗ مُوۡسٰي هَلۡ اَتَّبِعُكَ عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡ تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمَّا عُلِّمۡتَ رُشۡدًا
verses.en: Moses said to him: "May I follow thee, on the footing that thou teach me something of the (Higher) Truth which thou hast been taught

verses.ar: قَالَ اِنَّكَ لَنۡ تَسۡتَطِيۡعَ مَعِيَ صَبۡرًا
verses.en: (The other) said: "Verily thou wilt not be able to have patience with me

verses.ar: وَكَيۡفَ تَصۡبِرُ عَلٰي مَا لَمۡ تُحِطۡ بِهٖ خُبۡرًا
verses.en: And how canst thou have patience about things about which thy understanding is not complete

verses.ar: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِيۡ٘ اِنۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ صَابِرًا وَّلَا٘ اَعۡصِيۡ لَكَ اَمۡرًا
verses.en: Moses said: "Thou wilt find me, if Allah so will, (truly) patient: nor shall I disobey thee in aught

verses.ar: قَالَ فَاِنِ اتَّبَعۡتَنِيۡ فَلَا تَسۡـَٔلۡنِيۡ عَنۡ شَيۡءٍ حَتّٰ٘ي اُحۡدِثَ لَكَ مِنۡهُ ذِكۡرًاࣖ‏
verses.en: The other said: "If then thou wouldst follow me, ask me no questions about anything until I myself speak to thee concerning it

verses.ar: فَانۡطَلَقَاࣞ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا رَكِبَا فِي السَّفِيۡنَةِ خَرَقَهَاؕ قَالَ اَخَرَقۡتَهَا لِتُغۡرِقَ اَهۡلَهَاۚ لَقَدۡ جِئۡتَ شَيۡـًٔا اِمۡرًا
verses.en: So they both proceeded: until, when they were in the boat, he scuttled it. Said Moses: "Hast thou scuttled it in order to drown those in it? Truly a strange thing hast thou done

verses.ar: قَالَ اَلَمۡ اَقُلۡ اِنَّكَ لَنۡ تَسۡتَطِيۡعَ مَعِيَ صَبۡرًا
verses.en: He answered: "Did I not tell thee that thou canst have no patience with me

verses.ar: قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنِيۡ بِمَا نَسِيۡتُ وَلَا تُرۡهِقۡنِيۡ مِنۡ اَمۡرِيۡ عُسۡرًا
verses.en: Moses said: "Rebuke me not for forgetting, nor grieve me by raising difficulties in my case

verses.ar: فَانۡطَلَقَاࣞ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا لَقِيَا غُلٰمًا فَقَتَلَهٗۙ قَالَ اَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسًا زَكِيَّةًۭ بِغَيۡرِ نَفۡسٍؕ لَقَدۡ جِئۡتَ شَيۡـًٔا نُّكۡرًا
verses.en: Then they proceeded: until, when they met a young man, he slew him. Moses said: "Hast thou slain an innocent person who had slain none? Truly a foul (unheard of) thing hast thou done

verses.ar: قَالَ اَلَمۡ اَقُلۡ لَّكَ اِنَّكَ لَنۡ تَسۡتَطِيۡعَ مَعِيَ صَبۡرًا
verses.en: He answered: "Did I not tell thee that thou canst have no patience with me

verses.ar: قَالَ اِنۡ سَاَلۡتُكَ عَنۡ شَيۡءٍۭ بَعۡدَهَا فَلَا تُصٰحِبۡنِيۡۚ قَدۡ بَلَغۡتَ مِنۡ لَّدُنِّيۡ عُذۡرًا
verses.en: (Moses) said: "If ever I ask thee about anything after this, keep me not in thy company: then wouldst thou have received (full) excuse from my side

verses.ar: فَانۡطَلَقَاࣞ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا٘ اَتَيَا٘ اَهۡلَ قَرۡيَةِ اِۨسۡتَطۡعَمَا٘ اَهۡلَهَا فَاَبَوۡا اَنۡ يُّضَيِّفُوۡهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيۡهَا جِدَارًا يُّرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يَّنۡقَضَّ فَاَقَامَهٗؕ قَالَ لَوۡ شِئۡتَ لَتَّخَذۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ اَجۡرًا
verses.en: Then they proceeded: until, when they came to the inhabitants of a town, they asked them for food, but they refused them hospitality. They found there a wall on the point of falling down, but he set it up straight. (Moses) said: "If thou hadst wished, surely thou couldst have exacted some recompense for it

verses.ar: قَالَ هٰذَا فِرَاقُ بَيۡنِيۡ وَبَيۡنِكَۚ سَاُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَاۡوِيۡلِ مَا لَمۡ تَسۡتَطِعۡ عَّلَيۡهِ صَبۡرًا
verses.en: He answered: "This is the parting between me and thee: now will I tell thee the interpretation of (those things) over which thou wast unable to hold patience

verses.ar: اَمَّا السَّفِيۡنَةُ فَكَانَتۡ لِمَسٰكِيۡنَ يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ فِي الۡبَحۡرِ فَاَرَدۡتُّ اَنۡ اَعِيۡبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَآءَهُمۡ مَّلِكٌ يَّاۡخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِيۡنَةٍ غَصۡبًا
verses.en: As for the boat, it belonged to certain men in dire want: they plied on the water: I but wished to render it unserviceable, for there was after them a certain king who seized on every boat by force

verses.ar: وَاَمَّا الۡغُلٰمُ فَكَانَ اَبَوٰهُ مُؤۡمِنَيۡنِ فَخَشِيۡنَا٘ اَنۡ يُّرۡهِقَهُمَا طُغۡيَانًا وَّكُفۡرًاۚ‏
verses.en: As for the youth, his parents were people of Faith, and we feared that he would grieve them by obstinate rebellion and ingratitude (to Allah and man)

verses.ar: فَاَرَدۡنَا٘ اَنۡ يُّبۡدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيۡرًا مِّنۡهُ زَكٰوةً وَّاَقۡرَبَ رُحۡمًا
verses.en: So we desired that their Lord would give them in exchange (a son) better in purity (of conduct) and closer in affection

verses.ar: وَاَمَّا الۡجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلٰمَيۡنِ يَتِيۡمَيۡنِ فِي الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ وَكَانَ تَحۡتَهٗ كَنۡزٌ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ اَبُوۡهُمَا صَالِحًاۚ فَاَرَادَ رَبُّكَ اَنۡ يَّبۡلُغَا٘ اَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسۡتَخۡرِجَا كَنۡزَهُمَاࣗۖ رَحۡمَةً مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَۚ وَمَا فَعَلۡتُهٗ عَنۡ اَمۡرِيۡؕ ذٰلِكَ تَاۡوِيۡلُ مَا لَمۡ تَسۡطِعۡ عَّلَيۡهِ صَبۡرًاؕࣖ‏
verses.en: As for the wall, it belonged to two youths, orphans, in the Town; there was, beneath it, a buried treasure, to which they were entitled: their father had been a righteous man: So thy Lord desired that they should attain their age of full strength and get out their treasure - a mercy (and favour) from thy Lord. I did it not of my own accord. Such is the interpretation of (those things) over which thou wast unable to hold patience

verses.ar: وَيَسۡـَٔلُوۡنَكَ عَنۡ ذِي الۡقَرۡنَيۡنِؕ قُلۡ سَاَتۡلُوۡا عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡهُ ذِكۡرًاؕ‏
verses.en: They ask thee concerning Zul-qarnain. Say, "I will rehearse to you something of his story

verses.ar: اِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهٗ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُ مِنۡ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ سَبَبًاۙ‏
verses.en: Verily We established his power on earth, and We gave him the ways and the means to all ends

verses.ar: فَاَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا
verses.en: One (such) way he followed

verses.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا بَلَغَ مَغۡرِبَ الشَّمۡسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغۡرُبُ فِيۡ عَيۡنٍ حَمِئَةٍ وَّوَجَدَ عِنۡدَهَا قَوۡمًا ࣢ؕ قُلۡنَا يٰذَا الۡقَرۡنَيۡنِ اِمَّا٘ اَنۡ تُعَذِّبَ وَاِمَّا٘ اَنۡ تَتَّخِذَ فِيۡهِمۡ حُسۡنًا
verses.en: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun, he found it set in a spring of murky water: Near it he found a People: We said: "O Zul-qarnain! (thou hast authority,) either to punish them, or to treat them with kindness

verses.ar: قَالَ اَمَّا مَنۡ ظَلَمَ فَسَوۡفَ نُعَذِّبُهٗ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ اِلٰي رَبِّهٖ فَيُعَذِّبُهٗ عَذَابًا نُّكۡرًا
verses.en: He said: "Whoever doth wrong, him shall we punish; then shall he be sent back to his Lord; and He will punish him with a punishment unheard-of (before)

verses.ar: وَاَمَّا مَنۡ اٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلَهٗ جَزَآءَ اِۨلۡحُسۡنٰيۚ وَسَنَقُوۡلُ لَهٗ مِنۡ اَمۡرِنَا يُسۡرًاؕ‏
verses.en: But whoever believes, and works righteousness,- he shall have a goodly reward, and easy will be his task as We order it by our Command

verses.ar: ثُمَّ اَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا
verses.en: Then followed he (another) way

verses.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا بَلَغَ مَطۡلِعَ الشَّمۡسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطۡلُعُ عَلٰي قَوۡمٍ لَّمۡ نَجۡعَلۡ لَّهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِهَا سِتۡرًاۙ‏
verses.en: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had provided no covering protection against the sun

verses.ar: كَذٰلِكَؕ وَقَدۡ اَحَطۡنَا بِمَا لَدَيۡهِ خُبۡرًا
verses.en: (He left them) as they were: We completely understood what was before him

verses.ar: ثُمَّ اَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا
verses.en: Then followed he (another) way

verses.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا بَلَغَ بَيۡنَ السَّدَّيۡنِ وَجَدَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهِمَا قَوۡمًاۙ لَّا يَكَادُوۡنَ يَفۡقَهُوۡنَ قَوۡلًا
verses.en: Until, when he reached (a tract) between two mountains, he found, beneath them, a people who scarcely understood a word

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰذَا الۡقَرۡنَيۡنِ اِنَّ يَاۡجُوۡجَ وَمَاۡجُوۡجَ مُفۡسِدُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَهَلۡ نَجۡعَلُ لَكَ خَرۡجًا عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡ تَجۡعَلَ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ سَدًّا
verses.en: They said: "O Zul-qarnain! the Gog and Magog (People) do great mischief on earth: shall we then render thee tribute in order that thou mightest erect a barrier between us and them

verses.ar: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّيۡ فِيۡهِ رَبِّيۡ خَيۡرٌ فَاَعِيۡنُوۡنِيۡ بِقُوَّةٍ اَجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ رَدۡمًاۙ‏
verses.en: He said: "(The power) in which my Lord has established me is better (than tribute): Help me therefore with strength (and labour): I will erect a strong barrier between you and them

verses.ar: اٰتُوۡنِيۡ زُبَرَ الۡحَدِيۡدِؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا سَاوٰي بَيۡنَ الصَّدَفَيۡنِ قَالَ انۡفُخُوۡاؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا جَعَلَهٗ نَارًاۙ قَالَ اٰتُوۡنِيۡ٘ اُفۡرِغۡ عَلَيۡهِ قِطۡرًاؕ‏
verses.en: Bring me blocks of iron." At length, when he had filled up the space between the two steep mountain-sides, He said, "Blow (with your bellows)" Then, when he had made it (red) as fire, he said: "Bring me, that I may pour over it, molten lead

verses.ar: فَمَا اسۡطَاعُوۡ٘ا اَنۡ يَّظۡهَرُوۡهُ وَمَا اسۡتَطَاعُوۡا لَهٗ نَقۡبًا
verses.en: Thus were they made powerless to scale it or to dig through it

verses.ar: قَالَ هٰذَا رَحۡمَةٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّيۡۚ فَاِذَا جَآءَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّيۡ جَعَلَهٗ دَكَّآءَۚ وَكَانَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّيۡ حَقًّاؕ‏
verses.en: He said: "This is a mercy from my Lord: But when the promise of my Lord comes to pass, He will make it into dust; and the promise of my Lord is true

verses.ar: وَتَرَكۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٍ يَّمُوۡجُ فِيۡ بَعۡضٍ وَّنُفِخَ فِي الصُّوۡرِ فَجَمَعۡنٰهُمۡ جَمۡعًاۙ‏
verses.en: On that day We shall leave them to surge like waves on one another: the trumpet will be blown, and We shall collect them all together

verses.ar: وَّعَرَضۡنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ عَرۡضَاۙ‏
verses.en: And We shall present Hell that day for Unbelievers to see, all spread out

verses.ar: اِۨلَّذِيۡنَ كَانَتۡ اَعۡيُنُهُمۡ فِيۡ غِطَآءٍ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِيۡ وَكَانُوۡا لَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ سَمۡعًاࣖ‏
verses.en: (Unbelievers) whose eyes had been under a veil from remembrance of Me, and who had been unable even to hear

verses.ar: اَفَحَسِبَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اَنۡ يَّتَّخِذُوۡا عِبَادِيۡ مِنۡ دُوۡنِيۡ٘ اَوۡلِيَآءَؕ اِنَّا٘ اَعۡتَدۡنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ نُزُلًا
verses.en: Do the Unbelievers think that they can take My servants as protectors besides Me? Verily We have prepared Hell for the Unbelievers for (their) entertainment

verses.ar: قُلۡ هَلۡ نُنَبِّئُكُمۡ بِالۡاَخۡسَرِيۡنَ اَعۡمَالًاؕ‏
verses.en: Say: "Shall we tell you of those who lose most in respect of their deeds

verses.ar: اَلَّذِيۡنَ ضَلَّ سَعۡيُهُمۡ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَهُمۡ يَحۡسَبُوۡنَ اَنَّهُمۡ يُحۡسِنُوۡنَ صُنۡعًا
verses.en: Those whose efforts have been wasted in this life, while they thought that they were acquiring good by their works

verses.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَلِقَآئِهٖ فَحَبِطَتۡ اَعۡمَالُهُمۡ فَلَا نُقِيۡمُ لَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ وَزۡنًا
verses.en: They are those who deny the Signs of their Lord and the fact of their having to meet Him (in the Hereafter): vain will be their works, nor shall We, on the Day of Judgment, give them any weight

verses.ar: ذٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمۡ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوۡا وَاتَّخَذُوۡ٘ا اٰيٰتِيۡ وَرُسُلِيۡ هُزُوًا
verses.en: That is their reward, Hell, because they rejected Faith, and took My Signs and My Messengers by way of jest

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ كَانَتۡ لَهُمۡ جَنّٰتُ الۡفِرۡدَوۡسِ نُزُلًاۙ‏
verses.en: As to those who believe and work righteous deeds, they have, for their entertainment, the Gardens of Paradise

verses.ar: خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا لَا يَبۡغُوۡنَ عَنۡهَا حِوَلًا
verses.en: Wherein they shall dwell (for aye): no change will they wish for from them

verses.ar: قُلۡ لَّوۡ كَانَ الۡبَحۡرُ مِدَادًا لِّكَلِمٰتِ رَبِّيۡ لَنَفِدَ الۡبَحۡرُ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ تَنۡفَدَ كَلِمٰتُ رَبِّيۡ وَلَوۡ جِئۡنَا بِمِثۡلِهٖ مَدَدًا
verses.en: Say: "If the ocean were ink (wherewith to write out) the words of my Lord, sooner would the ocean be exhausted than would the words of my Lord, even if we added another ocean like it, for its aid

verses.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّمَا٘ اَنَا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يُوۡحٰ٘ي اِلَيَّ اَنَّمَا٘ اِلٰهُكُمۡ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌۚ فَمَنۡ كَانَ يَرۡجُوۡا لِقَآءَ رَبِّهٖ فَلۡيَعۡمَلۡ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا وَّلَا يُشۡرِكۡ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهٖ٘ اَحَدًاࣖ‏
verses.en: Say: "I am but a man like yourselves, (but) the inspiration has come to me, that your Allah is one Allah: whoever expects to meet his Lord, let him work righteousness, and, in the worship of his Lord, admit no one as partner
